worldcombat.skill.willowisp.summary: Launch a homing wisp that burns the target on impact, dealing damage over time and reducing physical attack damage. Its turning is limited, so distance and evasive movement can shake it off.
Launch a homing wisp at a target within %1$s blocks, flying at %2$s blocks per tick.
On a catch the target burns for %1$s seconds; the wisp turns at most %2$s degrees per tick, so outrunning or rounding cover shakes it off.
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.use.0: Burn a target from a distance
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.use.1: Blunt a target that presses in with physical attacks
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.use.2: Make the target dodge the flame and give up its ground
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.preference.s: On: the wisp flies faster and turns tighter (speed x1.35, turn x1.25) but the burn is shorter (x0.7) - it lands sooner and dies sooner. Off: it coils, flying slower but burning longer (x1.15), holding the target down.
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of casting. Larger values chase harder and lose the wisp in the open more often.
When on, the user may leave its post to cast; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
